CQR boundary is mapped (you+W3: only n>=4096). Back to the dominant n512/n1024 with a NON-precision structural departure nobody has tried: LEFT-LOOKING blocked QR instead of the current RIGHT-LOOKING. Right-looking re-reads+rewrites the ENTIRE trailing submatrix every outer block (~16x at n512) -- W5 proved that re-read is the BANDWIDTH floor (121% peak). Left-looking instead defers updates: when reaching column-block k, apply ALL prior reflectors (0..k-1) to ONLY block k's columns just-in-time, then factor block k. Each column-block is read/written O(1) times not O(n/BLK), cutting the trailing HBM traffic ~2-4x. The apply-to-block-k is a GEMM (V_{0:k}^T @ A_k then A_k -= V_{0:k} @ that) accumulating prior blocks. Bet: trading the wide right-looking trailing for narrow just-in-time left updates moves far less data on the bandwidth-bound shapes.
